lines.text: Many learners say: I am boring in class.
Better: I am bored in class.

quiz.stem: The film is ___, so I am sleepy.

native.tip: للشعور نقول bored وللشيء boring: “I am bored in class.” وليس “I am boring in class.”.

en.hook: Do you say “I am boring in class”?
en.tip: For a feeling say bored; for a thing say boring: “I am bored in class.” not “I am boring in class.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I am boring in class.” 😅 For a feeling say bored; for a thing say boring, so the right sentence is “I am bored in class.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
